records.question: 论文中提到了哪几种提示词策略？它们的区别是什么？

records.question: Why does the Transformer architecture avoid recurrence entirely?
records.answer: The Transformer architecture avoids recurrence entirely because it is based solely on attention mechanisms, which allows it to draw global dependencies between input and output without relying on recurrent layers. This design enables significantly more parallelization and reduces training time while achieving superior translation quality.

records.question: How are positional encodings computed in this paper?
records.answer: In this paper, positional encodings are computed using sine and cosine functions of different frequencies. Specifically, for each position pos and each dimension i (where i indexes the dimension of the model), the positional encoding is defined as PE(pos, 2i) = sin(pos / 10000^(2i/d_model)) and PE(pos, 2i+1) = cos(pos / 10000^(2i/d_model)). These encodings are added to the input embeddings at the bottoms of the encoder and decoder stacks.
